items.source: Convenience method to easily create simple RepositoryRestConfigurer instances that solely want to tweak the RepositoryRestConfiguration.

items.source: Creates a new RepositoryResourceMappings from the given RepositoryRestConfiguration, PersistentEntities, and Repositories.
items.translation: 根据给定的RepositoryRestConfiguration、PersistentEntities以及Repositories，创建一个新的RepositoryResourceMappings。

items.source: Creates a new RepositoryRestHandlerMapping for the given ResourceMappings RepositoryRestConfiguration and Repositories.
items.translation: 为给定的ResourceMappings、RepositoryRestConfiguration和Repositories创建一个新的RepositoryRestHandlerMapping。

items.source: Creates a new RepositoryRestHandlerMapping for the given ResourceMappings and RepositoryRestConfiguration.
items.translation: 为给定的 ResourceMappings 和 RepositoryRestConfiguration 创建一个新的 RepositoryRestHandlerMapping。

items.source: Creates a new PersistentEntityToJsonSchemaConverter for the given PersistentEntities and ResourceMappings.
items.translation: 为给定的 PersistentEntities 和 ResourceMappings 创建一个新的 PersistentEntityToJsonSchemaConverter。

items.source: Configures the LinkRelationProvider to be used to calculate the LinkRelation defaults for repositories.
items.translation: 配置 LinkRelationProvider，用于计算存储库的 LinkRelation 默认值。

items.source: Creates a new BasePathAwareHandlerMapping using the given RepositoryRestConfiguration.
items.translation: 使用给定的RepositoryRestConfiguration创建一个新的BasePathAwareHandlerMapping。

items.source: Creates a new ProfileResourceProcessor with the given RepositoryRestConfiguration.
items.translation: 创建一个使用给定RepositoryRestConfiguration的新的ProfileResourceProcessor。

items.translation: 为给定的RepositoryRestConfiguration创建一个新的ProjectionDefinitionRegistar。

items.source: Set the MediaType to use as a default when none is specified.
items.translation: 将 MediaType 设置为默认值，当未指定时使用该默认值。

items.source: Set the default size of Pageables.
items.translation: 设置Pageable的默认大小。

items.source: Configures the RepositoryDetectionStrategy to be used to determine which repositories get exposed.
items.translation: 配置RepositoryDetectionStrategy，用于确定要暴露哪些仓库。

items.source: Convenience method to activate returning response bodies for all PUT and POST requests, i.e. both creating and updating entities.
items.translation: 一种便捷方法，用于为所有 `PUT` 和 `POST` 请求启用返回响应体，即同时涵盖实体的创建和更新操作。

items.source: Wire up the controller with a copy of RepositoryRestConfiguration.
items.translation: 使用RepositoryRestConfiguration的副本连接控制器。

items.source: Customize the given ResourceHandlerRegistry.
items.translation: 自定义给定的ResourceHandlerRegistry。

items.source: A special EntityLinks implementation that takes repository and current configuration into account when generating links.
items.translation: 一个特殊的EntityLinks实现，它在生成链接时会考虑仓库和当前配置。

items.source: The HttpMessageConverter used by Spring MVC to read and write JSON data.
items.translation: Spring MVC 用于读写 JSON 数据的 HttpMessageConverter。

items.source: Turns a domain class into a JsonSchema.
items.translation: 将域类转换为JsonSchema。

items.source: Special HandlerAdapter that only recognizes handler methods defined in the provided controller classes.
items.translation: 一个特殊的 HandlerAdapter，它仅识别在提供的控制器类中定义的处理方法。

items.source: The HandlerMapping to delegate requests to Spring Data REST controllers.
items.translation: 将请求委托给 Spring Data REST 控制器的 HandlerMapping。

items.source: Configures whether HAL will be served as primary representation in case on application/json is requested.
items.translation: 配置在请求 `application/json` 时，HAL 是否作为主要表示形式提供。

items.source: Set the list of domain types for which we will expose the ID value as a normal property.
items.translation: 设置将作为普通属性暴露 ID 值的域类型列表。

items.source: Configures the base path to be used by Spring Data REST to expose repository resources.
items.translation: 配置 Spring Data REST 用于公开存储库资源的基础路径。

items.source: Configures whether to enable enum value translation via the Spring Data REST default resource bundle.
items.translation: 配置是否通过 Spring Data REST 默认资源包启用枚举值翻译。

items.source: Set the name of the URL query string parameter that indicates how many results to return at once.
items.translation: 设置指示一次返回多少条结果的 URL 查询字符串参数的名称。

items.source: Set the maximum size of pages.
items.translation: 设置页面的最大尺寸。

items.source: Set the name of the URL query string parameter that indicates what page to return.
items.translation: 设置指示要返回哪个页面的 URL 查询字符串参数的名称。

items.source: Set whether to return a response body after creating an entity.
items.translation: 设置是否在创建实体后返回响应体。

items.source: Set whether to return a response body after deleting an entity.
items.translation: 设置是否在删除实体后返回响应主体。

items.source: Set whether to return a response body after updating an entity.
items.translation: 设置是否在更新实体后返回响应体。

items.source: Set the name of the URL query string parameter that indicates what direction to sort results.
items.translation: 设置指示排序方向的 URL 查询字符串参数名称。

items.source: Return the href for the profile link of a given baseUri and domain type mapping.
items.translation: 返回给定 baseUri 和域类型映射的配置文件链接的 href。

items.source: Return the href for the profile root link of a given baseUri.
items.translation: 返回给定 baseUri 的配置文件根链接的 href。
